translation.name: AMORE Seongsu
translation.summary: A K-beauty experience space in Seongsu where visitors can explore products and personalized beauty services in a renovated industrial setting.
translation.description: AMORE Seongsu is designed as an experiential beauty space rather than a conventional shop. Visitors can explore a wide range of beauty products and services in a renovated building with a garden-focused interior.
translation.local_tip: Some personalized beauty experiences may require reservations. Check the current program before visiting.
